description:
£175 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to present this spacious eight-bedroom student property, ideally situated on Manor House Road in the heart of Central Jesmond.

Perfectly positioned for student living, the property offers easy access to a wide range of local amenities and both Newcastle and Northumbria Universities. Osborne Road is also within walking distance, offering a fantastic selection of popular bars, restaurants and cafés.

Combining a prime location with convenient access to everything Jesmond and the city centre have to offer, this property makes an ideal student home.

Don't miss out! Contact My Property Box today to arrange your viewing.
